verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents first-party agent access to account data: AgentOS (MCP server plus CLI) lets agents read balances and build cashflow reports on the production account, and the CLI exposes a broad slice of the API. Payments settle into the multi-currency Airwallex Wallet rather than straight to a bank, and nothing documents settlement or payout reports that tie each deposit back to its individual charges. missing for 10: documented balance-transaction/settlement API, payout-to-charge reconciliation endpoint or report, evidence of per-deposit reconciliation workflows, independent hands-on corroboration
